priceFeatures: Observed positive-volume seconds only, rebuilt consistently for original and added calls. Fixed completed quote-relative 15/30/60-second windows and the first complete clock minute. Missing seconds are not synthetic fills. At least one observed second is required; stale-close and activity diagnostics are retained. No later candle enters the feature window.
cohort: Earliest recoverable quote per contract by availability, then posting time and row index. Missing first-reference outcomes are never replaced by later successful calls. Quote-plus-five-second entry, 60/180-second holds, 5% sale haircut and twice prior median fees on $20 or the prior-volume limit. Clip reference returns to [-1,1]. Use five/ten latest completed distinct other-contract references, ordered by conservative completion time. Require both actual exit and full planned observation horizon strictly before the feature time. Exclude the current contract.
scope: Historical prices from already examined dates. Original-text availability restricts coverage. Cohort references are paper outcomes, not executed transactions. Pre-call volume and fee inputs may be stale by the later entry time.
